What is LoRA fine-tuning in one sentence?
LoRA freezes the base model and trains small adapter matrices so you specialize behavior without rewriting all weights.
Should I full-finetune DeepSeek-V4-Flash on two Sparks?
No — serve it with the DSpark TP=2 recipe; use LoRA only on smaller models for personal data.
